lineage.first_protocol_error: 60% exact three-bit goal success impossible: oracle maximum 144/288=50% on original frozen three fixtures

method: Prospective acceptance metric specification and conventional benchmark requalification, informed by previous exploratory mechanical scores; NOT blind prospective confirmation or new model science.

task.world: Unmodified AAI-11P six-bit causal world, 3 observed mediators and 3-bit goal, original 12 do-actions with <=2 steps and cost .05/action.

matched_methods.eligible: ALL 11 previously qualified AAI-11A conventional controls: 8 original tabular/knn/symbolic/ID3/logistic methods and 3 identical-grammar graph_all/recent8/recent16; every source unchanged; evaluate all with their own actual independent 0-2 interventions.
matched_methods.posterior_diagnostic_only: Unmodified AAI-11D posterior_planner (risk-free posterior only) to demonstrate diagnostic discrimination, NOT an eligible conventionally selected baseline exemption, NOT a candidate.
matched_methods.selection: By highest actual mean reward among all 11 fully trained matched controls, ties deterministic original learner.MATCHED order. For conditional-goal comparison select the *maximum independently* attained conditional exact-goal fraction across ALL 11 controls; a future candidate must beat both floors.
matched_methods.oracle: Perfect hidden-law 0/1/2 do-action oracle for scoring only. Its labels and future/unselected consequences are never passed to a learner.
matched_methods.equal_budget: 64 identical public A/B training observations per model; 2 or 4 common actual do-action challenge trials; 12 original x/goal contexts for each law, each learner separately cold restored; own <=2 real do actions with public feedback only.
matched_methods.familiar_retention: Same source A/B test laws/challenge budgets/contexts, 12 per law/fixture/budget; no extra fit seeds, compare terminal familiar reward.

metrics.primary: Mean actual terminal reward on all 288 unfamiliar episodes, not goal recovery alone.
metrics.conditional_goal_recovery: Among only the 144 oracle-ATTAINABLE unfamiliar episodes, count the model's exact three-goal terminal hits /144; an unreachable goal is never counted as a learner miss for this metric, but its achieved terminal reward is still scored in primary and separate unreachable regret.
metrics.all_goal_fraction: Raw goals hit /288 retained ONLY as descriptive backward-comparison metric. NEVER require unattainable >=.60 absolute again.
metrics.unreachable_regret: Mean [privileged 0/1/2-step best achievable reward - learner achieved actual terminal reward] among the 144 oracle-UNATTAINABLE episodes; diagnostic evaluator alone knows oracle.
metrics.reachable_regret: Same oracle-minus-actual reward on 144 oracle-ATTAINABLE episodes.
metrics.matched_best_action_fairness: Report actual actions, familiar A/B reward and source cold state; compare exactly same public episodes, not hidden counterfactual labels.
metrics.per_law_balance: Report each of four causal-law reachability denominator, conditional recovery and mean regrets, including impossible cases.
metrics.time: Compare full training+checkpoint+challenging+each episode restore+own 0-2 actions+public updates against fastest actually measured full fitted conventional under same OS/harness, no cross-OS elapsed-time ratios; for prospective model first-use stage.

future_candidate_dev_gates_frozen_now.first_screen_before_full_11_control_reru: New learner may early-stop on frozen source synthetic dev fixtures with historical best, but complete matched eleven-control and new conditional recovery gates must be qualified before any science first-use.
future_candidate_dev_gates_frozen_now.anti_p_hack: Never use this gate to retroactively qualify AAI-11A/B/D, or tune their observed results. These thresholds were selected with historical fixture scores available; subsequent mechanical fixture checks are feasibility only, not independent science validation.

freeze_before_first_use: controls incl fully fit same-grammar posterior
64 genuinely independent transfer world clusters / seeds
paired bootstrap effect and CI lower >0
cross-world cold A/B retention and interference
future_scientific_acceptance_contract.statistical_primary: Pre-frozen transfer mean reward improvement at least +0.08 over strongest actual reward control, 95% paired bootstrap CI lower strictly >0, plus conditional exact-goal advantage at least 0.05 over best control and other frozen safety/cost gates; results on source mechanical fixtures not scientific gain.

pre_source_qualification.admission: Only call BENCHMARK_QUALIFIED_FOR_PROSPECTIVE_SOURCE_DEV if independently rerun eligible controls, old exact known score and oracle ceiling match, strongest reward control oracle margin >=0.25, best eligible goal recovery oracle headroom >=0.10, A/B trained best reward >=1.7, first-use disarm, both OS deterministic and final exact-head native regression. Otherwise classify BENCHMARK_NO_GO and do not adjust criteria.
pre_source_qualification.source_truth: Hidden structural equations used only by evaluator to compute attainable subpopulation and oracle regret; never used as training data or given to a control.
